_purpose: Provisions we know exist and deliberately do not encode. Published so a reviewer can see the boundary of the claim instead of discovering it. Every entry carries a status and a reason; `tests/test_contract.py::TestCoverageGaps` fails if a field is missing or a status is outside the allowed set.

gaps.provision: 47号令 第七十九条 — 其他变化，30 日内备案
gaps.reason: The table judges which route applies, not whether the clock was met. No days_since_change field exists, so a late filing cannot be detected — adding one would turn a routing judge into a compliance clock, and the caller's timestamps would have to be trusted.

gaps.provision: 47号令 第七十九条 第一款 — 实质性变化且可能影响安全有效
gaps.reason: The substantive judgement is carried by the caller's safety_effectiveness_assessed flag; the table accepts the conclusion, not the argument behind it.

gaps.provision: 各省对一类器械备案的实施细则
gaps.reason: Provincial implementing rules differ and are outside the central-law basis we verified; encoding them would mean picking provinces.

gaps.provision: MDR Art.120(3) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2023/607 — 2027-12-31 / 2028-12-31 endpoints
gaps.reason: The table judges significance, not transitional validity. Validity depends on certificate dates the case JSON does not carry.

gaps.provision: MDCG 2020-3 rev.1 — software change decision support
gaps.reason: Chart C is guidance on how to reach the significance conclusion; the rules encode the criteria (design/intended-purpose, cumulative), not the flowchart.

gaps.provision: FD&C §515C(a)(3)/(b)(3) — labeling, notification if the device does not function as intended, performance requirements
gaps.reason: The statute says the Secretary *may* require these; a plan without a notification clause is not thereby unlawful.

gaps.provision: FDA PCCP guidance (4 Dec 2024) — continuous learning / automatic update Q-Sub discussion
gaps.reason: A recommendation, not an obligation; making it a rule would manufacture a requirement the guidance does not impose.

gaps.provision: 21 CFR 892.2055 之外的 PCCP 器械分类特殊控制
gaps.reason: Each classification regulation carries its own special controls; only 892.2055 has been read end to end so far.

gaps.provision: 510(k) 变更分类之外的判据（如 510(k) 摘要与 SE 论证细则）
gaps.reason: This table answers 'is a new submission needed', not 'is the submission adequate'.
